question:
The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.

He picked up his lugage and crossed the road.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Lugage'** in the given sentence is incorrectly spelled. 
 
• The correct spelling is **'Luggage'**.
 
 
• **Example: **He packed his luggage for the trip.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- Option 2:** 'Luggage'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Laggage' (Option 1), 'Lugaze' (Option 3), and 'Lagage' (Option 4) are all misspelled and do not exist in the English language.
